description: This file defines the interface for stream and IO stream management in the lighttpd project, including structures, function prototypes, and inline functions for stream operations.

methods.name: li_stream_event_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a given liStreamEvent.

methods.name: li_stream_init
methods.description: Initializes a stream with a given event loop and callback.

methods.name: li_stream_acquire
methods.description: Increases the reference count of a stream.

methods.name: li_stream_release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count of a stream and frees if zero.

methods.name: li_stream_safe_release
methods.description: Safely releases a stream pointer, setting it to NULL.

methods.name: li_stream_safe_reset_and_release
methods.description: Resets and releases a stream pointer safely.

methods.name: li_stream_connect
methods.description: Connects a source stream to a destination stream.

methods.name: li_stream_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the source of a stream.

methods.name: li_stream_disconnect_dest
methods.description: Disconnects the destination of a stream.

methods.name: li_stream_reset
methods.description: Resets a stream, disconnecting both sides.

methods.name: li_stream_notify
methods.description: Notifies the destination that new data is available.

methods.name: li_stream_notify_later
methods.description: Schedules a notification for later.

methods.name: li_stream_again
methods.description: Indicates more data will be generated or read.

methods.name: li_stream_again_later
methods.description: Schedules the 'again' notification for later.

methods.name: li_stream_detach
methods.description: Detaches a stream from its job queue.

methods.name: li_stream_attach
methods.description: Attaches a stream to a different event loop.

methods.name: li_stream_set_cqlimit
methods.description: Sets the chunk queue limit for a range of streams.

methods.name: li_streams_empty
methods.description: Checks if all chunk queues in a range of streams are empty.

methods.name: li_stream_plug_new
methods.description: Creates a new plug stream (forwarder).

methods.name: li_stream_null_new
methods.description: Creates a new null stream that consumes all data.

methods.name: li_iostream_event_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a given liIOStreamEvent.

methods.name: li_iostream_new
methods.description: Creates a new IO stream associated with a worker and file descriptor.

methods.name: li_iostream_acquire
methods.description: Increases the reference count of an IO stream.

methods.name: li_iostream_release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count of an IO stream.

methods.name: li_iostream_safe_release
methods.description: Safely releases an IO stream pointer, setting it to NULL.

methods.name: li_iostream_reset
methods.description: Resets an IO stream, closing the file descriptor.

methods.name: li_iostream_throttle_clear
methods.description: Clears throttling on an IO stream.

methods.name: li_iostream_detach
methods.description: Detaches an IO stream from its event loop.

methods.name: li_iostream_attach
methods.description: Attaches an IO stream to a different worker.

methods.name: li_stream_simple_socket_close
methods.description: Closes a socket stream, optionally aborted.

methods.name: li_stream_simple_socket_io_cb
methods.description: IO callback for socket streams, using stream->data as buffer.

methods.name: li_stream_simple_socket_io_cb_with_buffer
methods.description: IO callback with buffer management.

methods.name: li_stream_simple_socket_flush
methods.description: Flushes TCP socket data by disabling Nagle's algorithm.
